meta.title: Repetition of Departure
meta.description: The silence of destiny is hereby revoked.

units.rawText: Layer upon layer of tentacle-like lifeforms grow on the towering, oppressive walls, rising and falling rhythmically, as if they were breathing. Impelled by gravity, the slime they secrete drips noisily on the ground, punctuated by the occasional Low Order Entropic baring a forest of pale teeth at us as it growls. However, no attack follows this threatening display.
units.displayText: Layer upon layer of tentacle-like lifeforms grow on the towering, oppressive walls, rising and falling rhythmically, as if they were breathing. Impelled by gravity, the slime they secrete drips noisily on the ground, punctuated by the occasional Low Order Entropic baring a forest of pale teeth at us as it growls. However, no attack follows this threatening display.

spans.text: Layer upon layer of tentacle-like lifeforms grow on the towering, oppressive walls, rising and falling rhythmically, as if they were breathing. However, no attack follows this threatening display.

units.rawText: Demiurge travels happily onward as if there is nothing in her way. Persicaria and I, however, are much more cautious as we follow behind her.
units.displayText: Demiurge travels happily onward as if there is nothing in her way. Persicaria and I, however, are much more cautious as we follow behind her.

spans.text: Demiurge travels happily onward as if there is nothing in her way. Persicaria and I, however, are much more cautious as we follow behind her.

units.rawText: Professor, we're making much better time than expected. Based on the distance we've travelled, we might be approaching the Middle Ring soon.
units.displayText: Professor, we're making much better time than expected. Based on the distance we've travelled, we might be approaching the Middle Ring soon.

spans.text: Professor, we're making much better time than expected. Based on the distance we've travelled, we might be approaching the Middle Ring soon.

units.rawText: We've hardly encountered any Entropics on our way here. Even when we did, they immediately fled, with no intention of attacking us.
units.displayText: We've hardly encountered any Entropics on our way here. Even when we did, they immediately fled, with no intention of attacking us.

spans.text: We've hardly encountered any Entropics on our way here. Even when we did, they immediately fled, with no intention of attacking us.

units.rawText: It is in the nature of Entropics to consume agents, yet they're going against the most basic of instincts. Perhaps it's because of our "guide".
units.displayText: It is in the nature of Entropics to consume agents, yet they're going against the most basic of instincts. Perhaps it's because of our "guide".

spans.text: It is in the nature of Entropics to consume agents, yet they're going against the most basic of instincts. Perhaps it's because of our "guide".

units.rawText: Demiurge favors us, and the Low Order Entropics won't dare act up since a High Order Entropic like herself is scaring them off.
units.displayText: Demiurge favors us, and the Low Order Entropics won't dare act up since a High Order Entropic like herself is scaring them off.

spans.text: Demiurge favors us, and the Low Order Entropics won't dare act up since a High Order Entropic like herself is scaring them off.

units.rawText: Well, if that's the case, then Malkira's really pulled out all the stops just to see us. Having Demiurge lead the way and the Entropics line our path is one hell of a formal welcome.
units.displayText: Well, if that's the case, then Malkira's really pulled out all the stops just to see us. Having Demiurge lead the way and the Entropics line our path is one hell of a formal welcome.

spans.text: Well, if that's the case, then Malkira's really pulled out all the stops just to see us. Having Demiurge lead the way and the Entropics line our path is one hell of a formal welcome.

units.rawText: Still, we don't know Malkira's true objective. We can't lower our guards until we figure out what she's planning.
units.displayText: Still, we don't know Malkira's true objective. We can't lower our guards until we figure out what she's planning.

spans.text: Still, we don't know Malkira's true objective. We can't lower our guards until we figure out what she's planning.

units.rawText: We are getting closer and closer to the Watchtower wreathed in dense purple vapor. A sense of deja vu wells up in my heart and I come to a stop.
units.displayText: We are getting closer and closer to the Watchtower wreathed in dense purple vapor. A sense of deja vu wells up in my heart and I come to a stop.

spans.text: We are getting closer and closer to the Watchtower wreathed in dense purple vapor. A sense of
deja vu
wells up in my heart and I come to a stop.

units.rawText: Is something wrong, Professor?
units.displayText: Is something wrong, Professor?

spans.text: Is something wrong, Professor?

units.rawText: I think I know where she's taking us. Remember what I told you about the events in Eosphorus' neural fragment?
units.displayText: I think I know where she's taking us. Remember what I told you about the events in Eosphorus' neural fragment?

spans.text: I think I know where she's taking us. Remember what I told you about the events in Eosphorus' neural fragment?

units.rawText: Back then, I was traveling with a Sanctifier named Atlas to recover a device called the Rubik's Map from a Watchtower. We are currently headed straight for that Watchtower.
units.displayText: Back then, I was traveling with a Sanctifier named Atlas to recover a device called the Rubik's Map from a Watchtower. We are currently headed straight for that Watchtower.

spans.text: Back then, I was traveling with a Sanctifier named Atlas to recover a device called the Rubik's Map from a Watchtower. We are currently headed straight for that Watchtower.

units.rawText: Could Malkira's gift be that so-called Rubik's Map?
units.displayText: Could Malkira's gift be that so-called Rubik's Map?

spans.text: Could Malkira's gift be that so-called Rubik's Map?

units.rawText: With the Map, we'll be able to track the shifts in Tartarus in real time and analyze it to learn the positions of various key locations. That way, we won't have to worry even when the labyrinth shifts.
units.displayText: With the Map, we'll be able to track the shifts in Tartarus in real time and analyze it to learn the positions of various key locations. That way, we won't have to worry even when the labyrinth shifts.

spans.text: With the Map, we'll be able to track the shifts in Tartarus in real time and analyze it to learn the positions of various key locations. That way, we won't have to worry even when the labyrinth shifts.

units.rawText: But for some reason, it feels like that "gift" Malkira mentioned isn't as simple as that...
units.displayText: But for some reason, it feels like that "gift" Malkira mentioned isn't as simple as that...

spans.text: But for some reason, it feels like that "gift" Malkira mentioned isn't as simple as that...

units.rawText: I shake my head and try to quell the uneasiness in my heart.
units.displayText: I shake my head and try to quell the uneasiness in my heart.

spans.text: I shake my head and try to quell the uneasiness in my heart.

units.rawText: In any case, the Rubik's Map will help our future movements. Let's just follow Demiurge and collect it.
units.displayText: In any case, the Rubik's Map will help our future movements. Let's just follow Demiurge and collect it.

spans.text: In any case, the Rubik's Map will help our future movements. Let's just follow Demiurge and collect it.

units.rawText: Mm, got it. Ah... she's wandered off...
units.displayText: Mm, got it. Ah... she's wandered off...

spans.text: Mm, got it. Ah... she's wandered off...

units.rawText: Despite her small size, she moves with incredible speed. Upon hearing us, she looks back and beckons us to follow her with a curl of her tentacles.
units.displayText: Despite her small size, she moves with incredible speed. Upon hearing us, she looks back and beckons us to follow her with a curl of her tentacles.

spans.text: Despite her small size, she moves with incredible speed. Upon hearing us, she looks back and beckons us to follow her with a curl of her tentacles.

units.rawText: Persicaria and I set our doubts aside for the time being and follow Demiurge to the Watchtower that I remember.
units.displayText: Persicaria and I set our doubts aside for the time being and follow Demiurge to the Watchtower that I remember.

spans.text: Persicaria and I set our doubts aside for the time being and follow Demiurge to the Watchtower that I remember.

units.rawText: Several minutes later, at a Watchtower on the outskirts of Tartarus.
units.displayText: Several minutes later, at a Watchtower on the outskirts of Tartarus.

spans.text: Several minutes later, at a Watchtower on the outskirts of Tartarus.

units.rawText: Demiurge seems to be tired now, given that she's sprawled over a nearby rock and resting. Persicaria eyes her surroundings warily, and after eliminating several hidden Low Order Entropics that posed threats, she turns to look at the stone platform in the center and connects to the dais there in order to check on the Rubik's Map's condition.
units.displayText: Demiurge seems to be tired now, given that she's sprawled over a nearby rock and resting. Persicaria eyes her surroundings warily, and after eliminating several hidden Low Order Entropics that posed threats, she turns to look at the stone platform in the center and connects to the dais there in order to check on the Rubik's Map's condition.

spans.text: Demiurge seems to be tired now, given that she's sprawled over a nearby rock and resting. Persicaria eyes her surroundings warily, and after eliminating several hidden Low Order Entropics that posed threats, she turns to look at the stone platform in the center and connects to the dais there in order to check on the Rubik's Map's condition.

units.rawText: The silvery-white Rubik's Map that floats above the platform is covered in so much liquid Entropy that it doesn't reflect any light. A long time has passed since the last time it left the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The silvery-white Rubik's Map that floats above the platform is covered in so much liquid Entropy that it doesn't reflect any light. A long time has passed since the last time it left the Watchtower.

spans.text: The silvery-white Rubik's Map that floats above the platform is covered in so much liquid Entropy that it doesn't reflect any light. A long time has passed since the last time it left the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Professor, the Map is alright. However, we'll need to enter an appropriate cipher to unbind it from its current location, and then there's the matter of access authorizations...
units.displayText: Professor, the Map is alright. However, we'll need to enter an appropriate cipher to unbind it from its current location, and then there's the matter of access authorizations...

spans.text: Professor, the Map is alright. However, we'll need to enter an appropriate cipher to unbind it from its current location, and then there's the matter of access authorizations...

units.rawText: Hm... Hang on? This is strange...
units.displayText: Hm... Hang on? This is strange...

spans.text: Hm... Hang on? This is strange...

units.rawText: Persicaria brings up her terminal that she's using for data analysis and sees a glaring red alert message.
units.displayText: Persicaria brings up her terminal that she's using for data analysis and sees a glaring red alert message.

spans.text: Persicaria brings up her terminal that she's using for data analysis and sees a glaring red alert message.

units.rawText: System has verified your identity and authorization. Welcome, [Professor Irida]. You currently possess [Maintainer]-level access privileges. Please note that your activity will be logged.
units.displayText: System has verified your identity and authorization. Welcome, [Professor Irida]. You currently possess [Maintainer]-level access privileges. Please note that your activity will be logged.

spans.text: System has verified your identity and authorization. Welcome, [Professor Irida]. You currently possess [Maintainer]-level access privileges. Please note that your activity will be logged.

units.rawText: However, the analysis program starts throwing up error messages as Persicaria continues entering commands.
units.displayText: However, the analysis program starts throwing up error messages as Persicaria continues entering commands.

spans.text: However, the analysis program starts throwing up error messages as Persicaria continues entering commands.

units.rawText: Warning: Insufficient access. You are not authorized to perform this operation. Please contact your administrator or try again with an account that possesses the appropriate authorizations. This action has been logged.
units.displayText: Warning: Insufficient access. You are not authorized to perform this operation. Please contact your administrator or try again with an account that possesses the appropriate authorizations. This action has been logged.

spans.text: Warning: Insufficient access. You are not authorized to perform this operation. Please contact your administrator or try again with an account that possesses the appropriate authorizations. This action has been logged.

units.rawText: Before we can further investigate, the Entropics outside the Watchtower begin acting up all of a sudden.
units.displayText: Before we can further investigate, the Entropics outside the Watchtower begin acting up all of a sudden.

spans.text: Before we can further investigate, the Entropics outside the Watchtower begin acting up all of a sudden.

units.rawText: Hssss—
units.displayText: Hssss—

spans.text: Hssss—

units.rawText: A group of Low Order Entropics has awakened. After sensing external agents inside the Watchtower, they pour in like a flood.
units.displayText: A group of Low Order Entropics has awakened. After sensing external agents inside the Watchtower, they pour in like a flood.

spans.text: A group of Low Order Entropics has awakened. After sensing external agents inside the Watchtower, they pour in like a flood.

units.rawText: It's as you predicted. The Entropics set up an alarm near the Map, and connecting to it set it off.
units.displayText: It's as you predicted. The Entropics set up an alarm near the Map, and connecting to it set it off.

spans.text: It's as you predicted. The Entropics set up an alarm near the Map, and connecting to it set it off.

units.rawText: Persicaria draws her sword and eyes the swarming Entropics.
units.displayText: Persicaria draws her sword and eyes the swarming Entropics.

spans.text: Persicaria draws her sword and eyes the swarming Entropics.

units.rawText: I'm ready to fight, but I'll leave cracking the Map to you.
units.displayText: I'm ready to fight, but I'll leave cracking the Map to you.

spans.text: I'm ready to fight, but I'll leave cracking the Map to you.

units.rawText: Don't worry, I've already done this before in Eosphorus' neural fragment. Antonina gave me the cipher key before we set out, so just let me handle it.
units.displayText: Don't worry, I've already done this before in Eosphorus' neural fragment. Antonina gave me the cipher key before we set out, so just let me handle it.

spans.text: Don't worry, I've already done this before in Eosphorus' neural fragment. Antonina gave me the cipher key before we set out, so just let me handle it.

units.rawText: I'll leave it to you then, Professor. I'll deal with this annoying lot for you.
units.displayText: I'll leave it to you then, Professor. I'll deal with this annoying lot for you.

spans.text: I'll leave it to you then, Professor. I'll deal with this annoying lot for you.

units.rawText: I'll leave it to you then, buddy. I'll keep a lookout for you.
units.displayText: I'll leave it to you then, buddy. I'll keep a lookout for you.

spans.text: I'll leave it to you then, buddy. I'll keep a lookout for you.

units.rawText: These similar scenes evoke a sense of dread in me, but I bite back my discomfort and begin to work.
units.displayText: These similar scenes evoke a sense of dread in me, but I bite back my discomfort and begin to work.

spans.text: These similar scenes evoke a sense of dread in me, but I bite back my discomfort and begin to work.

units.rawText: I follow my memories and start up the program, and line after line of code flits through my field of vision. The silvery cube glows as it takes in external operands.
units.displayText: I follow my memories and start up the program, and line after line of code flits through my field of vision. The silvery cube glows as it takes in external operands.

spans.text: I follow my memories and start up the program, and line after line of code flits through my field of vision. The silvery cube glows as it takes in external operands.

units.rawText: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Now disconnecting fixture...
units.displayText: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Now disconnecting fixture...

spans.text: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Now disconnecting fixture...

units.rawText: Persicaria, who's guarding the entrance, plunges into the Entropic hordes and carves a crimson road through their throng, sending purple liquid Entropy splashing all around. She is soon lost in the horde of Low Order Entropics.
units.displayText: Persicaria, who's guarding the entrance, plunges into the Entropic hordes and carves a crimson road through their throng, sending purple liquid Entropy splashing all around. She is soon lost in the horde of Low Order Entropics.

spans.text: Persicaria, who's guarding the entrance, plunges into the Entropic hordes and carves a crimson road through their throng, sending purple liquid Entropy splashing all around. She is soon lost in the horde of Low Order Entropics.

units.rawText: Demiurge watches all this with a bemused expression on her face. Despite the intimidation factor of a High Order Entropic being present, this particular pack seems strangely unaffected.
units.displayText: Demiurge watches all this with a bemused expression on her face. Despite the intimidation factor of a High Order Entropic being present, this particular pack seems strangely unaffected.

spans.text: Demiurge watches all this with a bemused expression on her face. Despite the intimidation factor of a High Order Entropic being present, this particular pack seems strangely unaffected.

units.rawText: <size=40>Look out!</size>
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Don't worry about me, Professor! Focus on the Map!
units.displayText: Don't worry about me, Professor! Focus on the Map!

spans.text: Don't worry about me, Professor! Focus on the Map!

units.rawText: Persicaria swings and swings, severing all the tentacles stabbing at her. The Entropics' screams drown out the pink-haired girl's words and render our conversation nearly unintelligible.
units.displayText: Persicaria swings and swings, severing all the tentacles stabbing at her. The Entropics' screams drown out the pink-haired girl's words and render our conversation nearly unintelligible.

spans.text: Persicaria swings and swings, severing all the tentacles stabbing at her. The Entropics' screams drown out the pink-haired girl's words and render our conversation nearly unintelligible.

units.rawText: We're almost there, just one last step...
units.displayText: We're almost there, just one last step...

spans.text: We're almost there, just one last step...

units.rawText: I look at the silvery Rubik's Map again. My experiences from Eosphorus' neural fragment tell me what I'm about to face. This time, I am no longer a mere servant fearfully gazing upon a god.
units.displayText: I look at the silvery Rubik's Map again. My experiences from Eosphorus' neural fragment tell me what I'm about to face. This time, I am no longer a mere servant fearfully gazing upon a god.

spans.text: I look at the silvery Rubik's Map again. My experiences from Eosphorus' neural fragment tell me what I'm about to face. This time, I am no longer a mere servant fearfully gazing upon a god.

units.rawText: This intricate item, which looks down upon us from a lofty perch, glows with the radiance of swirling operands, tightly interweaving the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics.
units.displayText: This intricate item, which looks down upon us from a lofty perch, glows with the radiance of swirling operands, tightly interweaving the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics.

spans.text: This intricate item, which looks down upon us from a lofty perch, glows with the radiance of swirling operands, tightly interweaving the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics.

units.rawText: Let the wheel of destiny be broken by a force from beyond it.
units.displayText: Let the wheel of destiny be broken by a force from beyond it.

spans.text: Let the wheel of destiny be broken by a force from beyond it.

units.rawText: Decryption complete. I can recover the Rubik's Map at any time...
units.displayText: Decryption complete. I can recover the Rubik's Map at any time...

spans.text: Decryption complete. I can recover the Rubik's Map at any time...

units.rawText: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?
units.displayText: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?

spans.text: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?

units.rawText: The moment I touch the Map, a creepy sensation ripples out from the Map in all directions.
units.displayText: The moment I touch the Map, a creepy sensation ripples out from the Map in all directions.

spans.text: The moment I touch the Map, a creepy sensation ripples out from the Map in all directions.

units.rawText: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the Map as though I've been electrocuted.
units.displayText: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the Map as though I've been electrocuted.

spans.text: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the Map as though I've been electrocuted.

units.rawText: The ancient curse levied by humanity echoes in my mind, and I stop my hand as it reaches out.
units.displayText: The ancient curse levied by humanity echoes in my mind, and I stop my hand as it reaches out.

spans.text: The ancient curse levied by humanity echoes in my mind, and I stop my hand as it reaches out.

units.rawText: (No... If I touch it now, it might end up affecting Persicaria in some way.)
units.displayText: No... If I touch it now, it might end up affecting Persicaria in some way.

spans.text: No... If I touch it now, it might end up affecting Persicaria in some way.

units.rawText: Squelch!
units.displayText: Squelch!

spans.text: Squelch!

units.rawText: A tentacle from the platform grips my arm, as though sensing my hesitation. More tentacles emerge from all around and crawl up my arm.
units.displayText: A tentacle from the platform grips my arm, as though sensing my hesitation. More tentacles emerge from all around and crawl up my arm.

spans.text: A tentacle from the platform grips my arm, as though sensing my hesitation. More tentacles emerge from all around and crawl up my arm.

units.rawText: Tsk!
units.displayText: Tsk!

spans.text: Tsk!

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor!</size>
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Persicaria hears me exclaim and swings her sword with all her might, beating back the hordes of Entropic creatures. Her blade traces a silver arc through the air, neatly slicing through the tentacles binding me.
units.displayText: Persicaria hears me exclaim and swings her sword with all her might, beating back the hordes of Entropic creatures. Her blade traces a silver arc through the air, neatly slicing through the tentacles binding me.

spans.text: Persicaria hears me exclaim and swings her sword with all her might, beating back the hordes of Entropic creatures. Her blade traces a silver arc through the air, neatly slicing through the tentacles binding me.

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: I'm free!
units.displayText: I'm free!

spans.text: I'm free!

units.rawText: Why... Why did the Entropics suddenly act up? This is nothing like when we came here... Urgh!
units.displayText: Why... Why did the Entropics suddenly act up? This is nothing like when we came here... Urgh!

spans.text: Why... Why did the Entropics suddenly act up? This is nothing like when we came here... Urgh!

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl shelters me behind her, fending off the tentacles from in front of her and holding off attacks that come from her sides.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl shelters me behind her, fending off the tentacles from in front of her and holding off attacks that come from her sides.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl shelters me behind her, fending off the tentacles from in front of her and holding off attacks that come from her sides.

units.rawText: In Eosphorus' memories, a change happened when a Sanctifier touched the Rubik's Map. But this time, I didn't touch the map and there was no creepy sensation either...
units.displayText: In Eosphorus' memories, a change happened when a Sanctifier touched the Rubik's Map. But this time, I didn't touch the map and there was no creepy sensation either...

spans.text: In Eosphorus' memories, a change happened when a Sanctifier touched the Rubik's Map. But this time, I didn't touch the map and there was no creepy sensation either...

units.rawText: Which means this upheaval is not part of the Tartarus Sector's "rules"!
units.displayText: Which means this upheaval is not part of the Tartarus Sector's "rules"!

spans.text: Which means this upheaval is
not
part of the Tartarus Sector's "rules"!

units.rawText: The Entropics of the Tartarus Sector fear Demiurge because Low Order Entropics are naturally subservient to High Order Entropics.
units.displayText: The Entropics of the Tartarus Sector fear Demiurge because Low Order Entropics are naturally subservient to High Order Entropics.

spans.text: The Entropics of the Tartarus Sector fear Demiurge because Low Order Entropics are naturally subservient to High Order Entropics.

units.rawText: There is only one reason why this servility would be gone...
units.displayText: There is only one reason why this servility would be gone...

spans.text: There is only one reason why this servility would be gone...

units.rawText: Rumble—
units.displayText: Rumble—

spans.text: Rumble—

units.rawText: There is a loud crash from the Watchtower and the ground shakes.
units.displayText: There is a loud crash from the Watchtower and the ground shakes.

spans.text: There is a loud crash from the Watchtower and the ground shakes.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Because there's another High Order Entropic present...</color>
units.displayText: Because there's another High Order Entropic present...

spans.text: Because there's another High Order Entropic present...

units.rawText: Crash!
units.displayText: Crash!

spans.text: Crash!

units.rawText: Shattered rocks fly all around and dust rises in a cloud. The shockwave engulfs countless Entropics and the impact sends the liquid Entropy splashing.
units.displayText: Shattered rocks fly all around and dust rises in a cloud. The shockwave engulfs countless Entropics and the impact sends the liquid Entropy splashing.

spans.text: Shattered rocks fly all around and dust rises in a cloud. The shockwave engulfs countless Entropics and the impact sends the liquid Entropy splashing.

units.rawText: The chunk of debris over my head sways precariously.
units.displayText: The chunk of debris over my head sways precariously.

spans.text: The chunk of debris over my head sways precariously.

units.rawText: <size=40>Professor! Fall back!</size>
units.displayText: Professor! Fall back!

spans.text: Professor! Fall back!

units.rawText: Persicaria shoves me aside and in the next moment, my previous position is buried by rocks. The collapsed chunks of stone separate us.
units.displayText: Persicaria shoves me aside and in the next moment, my previous position is buried by rocks. The collapsed chunks of stone separate us.

spans.text: Persicaria shoves me aside and in the next moment, my previous position is buried by rocks. The collapsed chunks of stone separate us.

units.rawText: (Coughs)
units.displayText: Coughs

spans.text: Coughs

units.rawText: Professor, are you alright?
units.displayText: Professor, are you alright?

spans.text: Professor, are you alright?

units.rawText: Yeah... I'm not hurt.
units.displayText: Yeah... I'm not hurt.

spans.text: Yeah... I'm not hurt.

units.rawText: As the dust clears, a dull gold figure is heading straight for Persicaria, its weapon slicing through the air and chopping down on Persicaria with tremendous force.
units.displayText: As the dust clears, a dull gold figure is heading straight for Persicaria, its weapon slicing through the air and chopping down on Persicaria with tremendous force.

spans.text: As the dust clears, a dull gold figure is heading straight for Persicaria, its weapon slicing through the air and chopping down on Persicaria with tremendous force.

units.rawText: Clang! Clang! Clang! Blade and sword collide with crisp impacts.
units.displayText: Clang! Clang! Clang! Blade and sword collide with crisp impacts.

spans.text: Clang! Clang! Clang! Blade and sword collide with crisp impacts.

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.rawText: Persicaria grits her teeth and barely manages to bring her sword up in response. The incredible, forceful blows make her fingers go numb.
units.displayText: Persicaria grits her teeth and barely manages to bring her sword up in response. The incredible, forceful blows make her fingers go numb.

spans.text: Persicaria grits her teeth and barely manages to bring her sword up in response. The incredible, forceful blows make her fingers go numb.

units.rawText: These moves...
units.displayText: These moves...

spans.text: These moves...

units.rawText: These moves are familiar, and so are these flames and this presence. Persicaria raises her head and stares into a pair of golden eyes.
units.displayText: These moves are familiar, and so are these flames and this presence. Persicaria raises her head and stares into a pair of golden eyes.

spans.text: These moves are familiar, and so are these flames and this presence. Persicaria raises her head and stares into a pair of golden eyes.

units.rawText: The bottle dangling at her chest grows hot, as though in response to something. Countless scenes from her memories flash before her eyes, but all of them star the same person.
units.displayText: The bottle dangling at her chest grows hot, as though in response to something. Countless scenes from her memories flash before her eyes, but all of them star the same person.

spans.text: The bottle dangling at her chest grows hot, as though in response to something. Countless scenes from her memories flash before her eyes, but all of them star the same person.

units.rawText: You... are you?!
units.displayText: You... are you?!

spans.text: You... are you?!

units.rawText: The newcomer whirls her blade around and Persicaria takes a deep breath, pouring all her strength into deflecting her opponent's chopping stroke. Persicaria's powerful counterstrike knocks her opponent's glaive away, and it spins through the air before impaling itself in the ground.
units.displayText: The newcomer whirls her blade around and Persicaria takes a deep breath, pouring all her strength into deflecting her opponent's chopping stroke. Persicaria's powerful counterstrike knocks her opponent's glaive away, and it spins through the air before impaling itself in the ground.

spans.text: The newcomer whirls her blade around and Persicaria takes a deep breath, pouring all her strength into deflecting her opponent's chopping stroke. Persicaria's powerful counterstrike knocks her opponent's glaive away, and it spins through the air before impaling itself in the ground.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: It tears through the flooring and cracks, in a manner akin to spiderwebs, spread out from the point of contact. Without saying a word, the blonde girl grabs its hilt once again and pulls her weapon free, becoming the center of the fissures in her weapon's place.

units.rawText: The fractured flooring below her takes the shape of an eclipsed sun, but even after being swallowed by the darkness, the corona that remains still glows faintly.
units.displayText: The fractured flooring below her takes the shape of an eclipsed sun, but even after being swallowed by the darkness, the corona that remains still glows faintly.

spans.text: The fractured flooring below her takes the shape of an eclipsed sun, but even after being swallowed by the darkness, the corona that remains still glows faintly.

units.rawText: I can't believe I'm actually seeing you again... We all missed you...
units.displayText: I can't believe I'm actually seeing you again... We all missed you...

spans.text: I can't believe I'm actually seeing you again... We all missed you...

units.rawText: The person in Persicaria's mind takes a distinct form and overlaps with the dull gold figure before her.
units.displayText: The person in Persicaria's mind takes a distinct form and overlaps with the dull gold figure before her.

spans.text: The person in Persicaria's mind takes a distinct form and overlaps with the dull gold figure before her.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=40>Sol, you're back at last!</size></color>
units.displayText: Sol, you're back at last!

spans.text: Sol, you're back at last!
